scope: Static review only; no build, runtime, client, server, Ghidra, or source changes.

skill_coverage.coverage: Previously complete readings reused; hashes rechecked unchanged.

binding.interpretation: The binder tests receiver+0xd0 bit 0x400. When clear, branch reaches LEA RVA 0x7bf30 at 0x6e832 and stores that address at receiver+0xf0 at 0x6e839.
binding.qualification: This describes the static binder path if it processes these UFunction descriptors and their flags are not later changed; no runtime +0xf0 binding was observed.

dispatch.interpretation: The handler calls receiver vtable slot +0x258 first and branches away when its result is nonzero. The retained Pawn vtable evidence maps slot +0x258 to RVA 0x6902c0; that static vtable sample does not prove the runtime receiver uses it.

actor_gate.range_note: The supplied .pdata/body evidence is split: the initial 72-byte range ends at 0x690308 and the retained continuation starts there. The continuation closes this path at ret 0x690581; bytes beginning 0x690590 are the next function and are excluded.
initial_checks: Function flags bit 13 set branches to false return.
Actor+0xe8 bit 0x08 set branches to false return.
Actor flags at +0x10 mask 0x2000000000000000 set branches to false return.
actor_gate.eligibility_seed: At 0x690315 actor byte +0xc2 is compared with 1. If <=1, EBP is initialized to 1 only when function flags & 0x500 == 0; if >1, EBP is set to 0.
relevant_later_conditions: For these exact flags, function bit 0x01000000 is clear, so the code branches to the +0x11c/+0x5b0 path at 0x690422, bypassing the earlier equality success route.
If byte [actor+0x11c]+0x5b0 is zero, return false at 0x690434.

If that byte is nonzero, function flag 0x40 is checked; for both exact function flags it is clear, so execution returns EBP through 0x69052d. Thus this branch returns 1 only if the earlier EBP seed was 1; for actor+c2>1 it returns 0.
Other earlier guards can also return false; the later flag-0x40 path is not reached for these two flag words.

conditional_answer.role2_to_actor_c2_mapping: Unknown; no reflection/layout pin was reviewed that maps Role2 to actor byte +0xc2.
conditional_answer.if_actor_c2_is_2: For the exact UFunction flags above, the static +0x258 handler path seeds EBP=0 and its ordinary branch cannot return true: the +0x01000000 path is disabled; the controller byte +0x5b0 must be nonzero to avoid immediate false, but +0x40 is also clear, so the handler returns EBP=0. Earlier guards can likewise return false.
conditional_answer.if_actor_c2_is_0_or_1: The handler can seed EBP=1 because these flags clear 0x500; however, earlier function/actor/global checks must pass and [actor+0x11c]+0x5b0 must be nonzero. This is only a conditional static path, not observed behavior.

unknowns: No runtime proof that binder 0x6e540 processes these exact descriptors or that +0xf0 remains bound to 0x7bf30.
No proven semantic mapping from Role2 to actor byte +0xc2.
No live actor vtable, class identity, slot +0x258 target, +0xc2 value, actor/controller +0x11c/+0x5b0 value, or callback invocation was observed.
